import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.EvaluatedGaussian
open Matrix MeasureTheory TopologicalSpace
set_option autoImplicit false

example : ∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ),
    let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
    let r : ℝ := (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) * ((s - 1) / (s + 1))
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let τ : Measure (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) :=
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).toSphere
    let σ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      (τ Set.univ)⁻¹ • τ.map (fun y => y.val)
    let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun y =>
      ((s + 1) * WithLp.ofLp y j0 - (s - 1)) /
        (1 + r ^ 2 - 2 * r * WithLp.ofLp y j0) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
    Integrable f σ ∧ (∫ y, f y ∂σ) = -(s - 1) / ((n : ℝ) * (1 - r ^ 2)) := selected_numerator_value

example : ∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ),
    let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
    let r : ℝ := (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) * ((s - 1) / (s + 1))
    let ℓ : ℝ := (4 * (n : ℝ) * s + (s - 1) ^ 2) /
      (8 * (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose)))⁻¹
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
        Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
          (((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
    let t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    let v : ℝ := ((-1 : ℝ) ^ n / (n : ℝ)) * ((s - 1) / (s + 1)) ^ n *
      (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) / (1 - r ^ 2)
    Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x ∂γ O)) (Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))) ∧
    Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x * p O x)) (Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))) ∧
    (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x ∂γ O) ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) = v ∧
    (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x * p O x) ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) = v := AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.EvaluatedGaussian.selected_gaussian_value
